name: Myeloid effector responses with degranulation and hypersensitivity
rationale: All members are myeloid/innate effector functions (neutrophil degranulation, ADCC, complement receptor signaling, acute antigen-driven inflammation); unlike the confusables it combines degranulation with type II/IV hypersensitivity and lacks Fc-inhibitory, SIRP or protease-regulation members.

qualifier: PLC-gamma and PI3K arms, Klotho co-receptors
name: FGFR PLC-gamma and PI3K cascades with Klotho co-receptors
rationale: Members are FGFR (and one ERBB2) signaling cascades centred on phospholipase C-gamma and PI3K arms plus Klotho-dependent ligand binding, whereas the confusables hold isoform ligand binding, FRS/SHC arms of FGFR1-3 and mutant FGFRs.

qualifier: myelination plus axon regeneration and caliber
name: Axon regeneration, caliber and glial myelination
rationale: Members cover CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, gliosis, axon diameter and neurofilaments together with injured-axon regeneration; the sprouting/guidance confusables lack the myelination side and the oligodendrocyte confusable lacks axon regeneration.

core: Endosomal recycling of receptors to the cell surface
name: Rab/ARF-controlled receptor recycling to cell surface and synapse
rationale: Members share endocytic recycling and surface delivery of receptors, notably postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors, regulated by Rab GAPs and ARF signaling, which the presynaptic and generic endosome confusables lack.

name: CSF1 and DAP12 signaling in macrophages and microglia
rationale: Members are CSF1/M-CSF and DAP12 tyrosine-kinase signaling driving macrophage and microglial proliferation, activation and migration; microglial and DAP12 members separate it from the osteoclast and monocyte-differentiation confusables.

core: Secretory-pathway maturation of developmental signaling proteins
name: Hedgehog lipidation and Notch O-glycosylation maturation
rationale: Members cover Hedgehog autoprocessing, palmitoylation and release and O-fucose/O-glucose glycosylation of Notch and TSR proteins in ER/Golgi, combining lipidation and O-glycosylation that the N-glycan, heparan sulfate and palmitoylation confusables each lack.

name: Perinatal alveolar maturation, pneumocytes and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members cover surfactant metabolism and its disorders, type I/II pneumocyte and saccule development and perinatal transitions (hyperoxia, ductus closure), distinguishing it from the lung branching and unrelated membrane/oxygen-transport confusables.

name: Inflammasome assembly, pyroptosis and IL-1/IL-18 maturation
rationale: Members are canonical and non-canonical (caspase-4/5) inflammasomes, pyroptosis and IL-1/IL-18 processing and signaling, which the TLR/NOD, IL-17 and chemokine confusables lack.

qualifier: systemic transport, cellular uptake and intracellular processing
name: Cobalamin systemic transport, cellular uptake and intracellular processing
rationale: Members concern cobalamin carriage by transcobalamin, CD320 uptake and MMACHC/MMADHC/ABCD4 processing, separating it from the dietary intrinsic-factor uptake and methylmalonyl-CoA mutase confusables.

name: Nephron tubule morphogenesis via comma- and S-shaped bodies
rationale: All members describe nephron tubule morphogenesis through comma- and S-shaped body stages, whereas confusables cover mesenchymal differentiation, MET, renal vesicle and ureteric bud events.

core: Organelle lumen pH regulation by V-ATPase
name: Endolysosomal and phagosomal lumen pH regulation
rationale: Members are V-ATPase-driven acidification and pH control of endosome, lysosome, Golgi and phagosome lumens including phagolysosome fusion, which the ion-exchanger, scramblase and pigmentation confusables lack.

name: Regulation of central carbon metabolism and isocitrate-derived NADPH
rationale: Members are growth- and stress-signaling control of glycolysis, pentose phosphate and TCA flux (mTORC1, p53, NRF2), and uniquely include isocitrate metabolism, NADPH regeneration and mutant-IDH 2-hydroxyglutarate absent from the NRF2 and hypoxia confusables.

name: Purine base salvage, PRPP synthesis and ribonucleoside catabolism
rationale: Members cover HPRT/APRT salvage, PRPP supply and ribonucleoside degradation (ADA, PNP, toward allantoin), distinguishing it from de novo purine synthesis and deoxypurine metabolism confusables.

name: Type II sodium-phosphate cotransport and phosphate homeostasis
rationale: Members are SLC34 Na+/Pi cotransport, its disorders and its hormonal (PTH) regulation, unlike the mineralization, anion-exchanger and FGF/Klotho confusables.

core: Unfolded protein and integrated stress responses
name: Unfolded protein and integrated stress responses, FOXO survival signaling
rationale: Members are ER/mitochondrial UPR, eIF2 kinase stress translation control and stress-induced apoptosis decisions, plus AKT-FOXO survival signaling that the ER folding/targeting and chaperonin confusables lack, while the NRF2 confusables lack the UPR.

core: Promotion of monocyte and macrophage recruitment
name: Monocyte and macrophage recruitment promoted by RAGE-p38 signaling
rationale: Members positively regulate monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation and MCP-1 production with AGE-receptor and p38 signaling, which distinguish it from monocyte-identity, negative-regulation and neutrophil chemotaxis confusables.

name: Xenobiotic and drug biotransformation, conjugation and transport
rationale: Members are drug ADME, CYP/FMO oxidation, conjugation (glucuronidation, sulfonation, methylation, acetylation) and xenobiotic/bilirubin transport, unlike the sulfur-methyl, bile acid and organic anion transport confusables.

name: Neutrophil and monocyte inflammatory activation with SIRP-mediated restraint
rationale: Members are neutrophil/monocyte inflammatory, complement and TLR activation and degranulation together with SIRP-mediated negative regulation of phagocytosis and neutrophil activation, which the chemotaxis/respiratory-burst confusable lacks; it lacks the Fc and hypersensitivity members of the other confusables.

name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting control
rationale: Members regulate axon regrowth after injury and collateral sprouting (growth stimulation and RHOA/ceramide inhibition, CRMP signaling, motor neuron survival), without the myelination of one confusable or the Sema3A repulsive guidance of others.

name: Target transcript-specific mRNA translational regulation
rationale: All four members regulate translation of a specific transcript (CDH1, CDH11, PD-L1, NPAS4), mostly via microRNAs, whereas confusables cover miRNA biogenesis, RISC machinery and general mRNA decay or stabilization.

core: Viral DNA integration and transcriptional latency
name: Viral DNA integration, latency and host retroelement silencing
rationale: Members cover retroviral reverse transcription and integration, herpesvirus events, host control of viral transcription and latency, and HUSH/KRAB-ZFP silencing of retroelements, which separate it from RNA-virus replication and APOBEC editing confusables.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination and synapsis
rationale: Members are meiotic DSB formation and repair, synaptonemal complex and telomere attachment, whereas confusables cover later meiotic cohesion, chiasma and segregation.

name: Rho GTPase-driven promotion of mitotic cytokinesis
rationale: Members are positive regulation of cytokinesis and the Rho GTPase cycle that drives it, distinct from spindle checkpoint and contractile ring/abscission execution confusables.

name: Genotoxic stress response and liver regeneration program
rationale: Members combine UV, cisplatin, bleomycin and phorbol ester response programs with hepatocyte proliferation, liver regeneration and morphogenesis, a two-strand theme whose liver arm distinguishes it from the senescence, light and oxidative-stress confusables.

name: Fc receptor and SIRP tuning of phagocyte and B-cell activation
rationale: Members are Fc receptor inhibitory/stimulatory and SIRP signaling that set thresholds for phagocytosis, neutrophil and B cell activation and antibody responses, unlike the ADCC/hypersensitivity and myeloid activation confusables.
